topics.title: Warhammer Day 2026: Previews, Exclusives and In-Store Rewards
topics.what_is_driving_it: Games Workshop's Warhammer Day announcement and the Spikey Bits 2026 guide are circulating ahead of the event, with the full preview lineup and exclusive rewards now public.
topics.relevance_note: Warhammer Day is a fixed annual moment with high search and discussion volume. A breakdown of the previews and rewards, and which ones are worth travelling for, fits the timing well.

topics.title: Golden Demon 2026 Winners and Spiel Essen Painting Highlights
topics.what_is_driving_it: The Golden Demon 2026 winners were revealed at SPIEL Essen, and the official roundup video has been published.
topics.relevance_note: Golden Demon winners are the benchmark for painting quality. Breaking down what separated the winning entries gives viewers concrete techniques to take into their own painting.
topics.gap_note: Official coverage shows the miniatures but rarely explains the techniques. Technique breakdowns, such as blending, OSL, or basing choices, from the winning categories would fill that gap.

topics.title: Do You Actually Need All These Miniature Paints?
topics.what_is_driving_it: Paint ranges keep expanding, with Squidmar's $400 72-colour bundle and a Spikey Bits editorial questioning whether hobbyists are getting better options or just more bottles. A viral Tone Pro paint-pot short is also drawing heavy views.
topics.relevance_note: Paint buying is a constant beginner question and the topic is currently being debated across several outlets. Viewers want a clear answer on which paints to buy and how to build a palette without overspending.
topics.gap_note: Coverage is mostly news and bundle reviews. A practical starter palette guide, or a 'build your palette for under £X' video, would own this question.

topics.title: Best Primer for Miniatures: Citadel vs P3 vs Army Painter
topics.what_is_driving_it: Spikey Bits has published a direct primer comparison, and the same question keeps recurring in hobby communities.
topics.relevance_note: Primer is one of the first decisions in any paint job, so this is a high-intent recurring question that viewers search for repeatedly.
topics.gap_note: Most primer content is written. A side-by-side video test covering coverage, finish, humidity and cold-weather use, with real miniatures, would be a strong format for this question.

topics.title: Building a Real Servo Hand Inspired by Commissar Yarrick's Power Klaw
topics.what_is_driving_it: A viewer-built physical servo hand modelled on Commissar Yarrick's power klaw is getting strong momentum as a short.
topics.relevance_note: Real-world builds of 40K-inspired props show a strong appetite for practical, maker-style content that goes beyond painting.
topics.gap_note: There is high interest in functional 40K props and very little long-form build coverage. A full build series showing the parts, electronics and finishing would be unusual and shareable.

topics.title: 3D Printed and Resin-Moulded Miniatures: Is It Worth It?
topics.what_is_driving_it: Several 3D printing shorts are performing well, including a flashforge printer for miniature creation, a resin mould injected with a squad of minis, and a custom figure service.
topics.relevance_note: Home 3D printing is spreading quickly among hobbyists who want custom or cheaper models. Viewers are asking whether it is worth it and what the process involves.
topics.gap_note: Shorts show spectacle but do not cover the workflow. A practical guide to printing, supporting, curing and painting 3D-printed 40K-style models would fill a clear gap.

topics.title: Can Warhammer 40K Catch Up to D&D?
topics.what_is_driving_it: A Heresy For Heretics short asking whether Warhammer can catch up to Dungeons & Dragons is getting strong engagement, alongside a wave of D&D content.
topics.relevance_note: The D&D comparison is a live debate among tabletop players. Viewers want a considered answer covering player numbers, accessibility and where 40K is growing.

topics.title: Dawn of War IV: Launch Trailer Reaction and Campaign Breakdown
topics.what_is_driving_it: The official Dawn of War IV overview trailer, the IGN trailer and an early hands-on review are all driving discussion about the game's four factions and 70+ missions.
topics.relevance_note: A major 40K game release is generating sustained interest, and viewers want to know how the factions and campaigns play and tie into the wider lore.
topics.gap_note: Coverage is split between trailers and single review opinions. A faction-by-faction breakdown linking each army to its lore and tabletop equivalent would stand out.

examples.cinematic_angle: Shoot a completed squad under the same lamp setup, slow pan across the ranks. Trigger the chorus on the moment the last unit comes into frame, so the apocalyptic swell lands on the finished army, not a single model.

examples.name: The Lost Battalion
examples.cinematic_angle: Slow pan across a Legion of the Damned squad with flame-effect lighting, the song's chorus hitting as the squad steps forward out of darkness. The track's war-history narrative and the Legion's ghostly silence make a strong pairing. Verify the track's licence before posting.
